name: One&Only Royal Mirage Dubai
positioning: Beachfront resort on Jumeirah Beach in Dubai, set in lush gardens with a kilometre of private beach and classic Arabian architecture
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with Dubai's skyline as a backdrop
Guests drawn to classic Arabian architecture and garden settings

facts.text: The resort has a kilometre of private beach.
The resort is set in lush gardens along Jumeirah Beach.
The resort overlooks Palm Jumeirah island and is near Dubai Marina.
The resort blends classic Arabian architecture with modern energy.
The resort is backdropped by Dubai's skyline.
Dubai International Airport is about a 30-minute drive from the resort.
The resort holds EarthCheck Silver status for its sustainable practices.
The resort can assist guests with a Dubai visa application.

highlights.text: Views over Palm Jumeirah island, near Dubai Marina.
Set in lush gardens along Jumeirah Beach.
Classic Arabian architecture blended with modern energy.

considerations.text: Guests are asked to dress and behave appropriately in respect of the local culture on excursions and in shopping malls.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
